title: 第 3章 青铜第4 章 十年一征
slug: 西幻从鹰人部落到天使帝国
content_zh:
鹰人逐山而居，世代生活在山上，极喜山崖之地。
他们在山顶周围，用石器凿开洞穴居住。
高蛮山只不过是太古费兰德世界中，极其寻常可见的小山。
而传闻中的鹰人王庭，则是居住在一座名叫“天山”的挺拔高山之上！
那是一座庞大壮美的高山，足足有几万鹰人栖居其上，那是鹰人的祖庭，高蛮山部落的鹰人也来源于此。
姜尤成为高蛮山部落的族长后，开始改造鹰人生活的环境。
石洞虽然安全，但历经很多代鹰人生活之后，里面的味道十分难捱，并且卫生方面一直是个问题。
第一年。
他磨制石斧，砍伐树木，带领着族人们，在一年的时间里，打造了几十间木屋和木床，成为新的居所。
原本的山洞打上木门，则是极好的储藏地。
鹰人的木屋有两个门，一个开在房顶，一个开在靠近山崖处，方便出行。
打造完木屋后，他又召集族人，在部落的中央挖坑凿了一方水池，作为平时饮用生活之水。
姜尤每日都会安排族人专门打水。
然后，他又用木墙将木屋群团团围住，这样，一个小小的村落便形成了。
木屋村落相比山洞的安全性可能要差点，但姜尤看着眼前的村落，头一次在莽荒之地感受到了文明的气息。
至此心安。
第二年冬。
姜尤带领鹰人少年们趁着冬季大雪，找到并杀死了密语森林中的几头正在冬眠的黑熊。
他的力量和技艺得到了成长，自己也换上了熊皮衣服。
很暖和。

第三年。
姜尤在密语森林的东方发现了一头魔兽。
好在这只魔兽是鹿属魔兽，此魔兽虽强，性情算是温和，一直待在自己的领地，让姜尤等人放下了心。
但他心中获取超凡之力的渴望却越加增强。
第四年。
姜尤带领狩猎队外出狩猎时，追逐野牛，往西方多飞了三千米。
在这里，他发现了一处露天的铜矿！
这让他惊喜莫名！
铜！
这是能够让他们从石器时代迈入青铜时代的东西。
若是有了铜器，高蛮山部落的实力能够提升一大截。
但很快，一位巡警的鹰人少年便从更远处飞来，告诉他，这里有一处蛇人部落。
蛇人族同样是泰坦巨人的附属种族，
不过，他们和鹰人一族世代交战，生活范围交错，自古是天敌！
在古老的时代，四足鹰还未进化为鹰人时，便时常捕捉蛇人的祖先两足蛇食用。
但当他们几乎同时接受泰坦巨人的馈赠点化，进化为智慧种族之后。
鹰人族对蛇人族的压制便消失了。
蛇人的繁殖能力更强，且他们善于使用弓箭。
鹰人虽然有飞行优势，但他们的鹰爪太过尖锐，不太支持他们射箭。
不然，一个可以在天空中射箭的兵种，哪怕只是普通凡物，没有超凡力量，也是有很大优势的。

在考虑了片刻之后，姜尤心中对铜的渴望战胜了对蛇人部落的担忧。
content_en:
The Eagle People live in the mountains and live on the mountains for generations, and they like the place on the cliffs very much.
They lived in caves carved with stone tools around the top of the mountain.
Gaoman Mountain is just an extremely common hill in the ancient world of Ferlander.
The rumored Eagle Man Wang Ting lives on a tall and tall mountain called "Tianshan"!
It is a huge and magnificent mountain, with tens of thousands of eagle people living on it. It is the ancestral home of the eagle people, and the eagle people of the Gaoman Mountain Tribe also come from here.
After Jiang You became the clan leader of the Gaoman Mountain Tribe, he began to transform the living environment of the Ying people.
Although the cave is safe, after many generations of Ying people have lived there, the smell inside is very unpleasant, and hygiene has always been a problem.
First year.
He sharpened stone axes, cut down trees, and led his tribe to build dozens of wooden houses and wooden beds within a year to become new residences.
The original cave, with a wooden door, was an excellent storage place.
The Eagle Man's wooden house has two doors, one opening on the roof and one opening near the cliff for easy travel.
After building the wooden house, he gathered the tribesmen and dug a pit in the center of the tribe to build a pool for daily drinking water.
Jiang You arranges for clan members to fetch water every day.
Then, he surrounded the wooden houses with wooden walls, and in this way, a small village was formed.
The wooden village may not be as safe as the cave, but Jiang You looked at the village in front of him and felt the atmosphere of civilization for the first time in the wilderness.
At this point I feel at ease.
The following winter.
Jiang You led the young eagle men to take advantage of the heavy snowfall in winter to find and kill several hibernating black bears in the Whispering Forest.
His strength and skills grew, and he changed into bearskin clothing.
Very warm.
Third year.
Jiang You discovered a magical beast in the east of the Whispering Forest.
Fortunately, this monster is a deer type monster. Although this monster is strong, it has a gentle temperament and has always stayed in its own territory, which made Jiang You and others feel relieved.
But the desire in his heart to obtain extraordinary power became stronger and stronger.
Fourth year.
When Jiang You led the hunting team out for hunting, they chased the bison and flew an extra three thousand meters to the west.
Here, he discovered an open-pit copper mine!
This surprised him!
copper!
This was the thing that would take them from the Stone Age to the Bronze Age.
If there are bronze weapons, the strength of the Gaoman Mountain tribe can be greatly improved.
But soon, a patrolling eagle boy flew in from further away and told him that there was a snake tribe here.
The snake people are also a subsidiary race of the Titans.
However, they have been at war with the Yingren clan for generations, and their living areas are intertwined. They have been natural enemies since ancient times!
In ancient times, before the four-legged eagle evolved into the hawk-man, it would often catch the two-legged snake, the ancestor of the snake-man, for food.
But when they accepted the gifts and enlightenment from the Titans almost at the same time, they evolved into an intelligent race.
The suppression of the Snake People by the Eagle People disappeared.
Snake people have greater reproductive capacity and are good at using bows and arrows.
Although the eagle people have the advantage of flying, their eagle claws are too sharp and do not support their archery.
Otherwise, a unit that can shoot arrows in the sky, even if it is just an ordinary mortal without extraordinary power, will still have great advantages.
After thinking about it for a moment, Jiang You's desire for copper defeated his worries about the snake tribe.
